description:
Somos Aeromonkeys, un equipo unido de la UNAQ impulsado por la ingeniería, la curiosidad y los retos.

¿Qué ofrecemos? Base en ingeniería, cálculo y datos, destacando por nuestra comunicación, trabajo colaborativo y disposición para compartir conocimientos.

¿Por qué unirte? Un ambiente dinámico donde el crecimiento mutuo es prioridad y cada propuesta cuenta.

¿Qué buscamos? Integrantes con pensamiento lógico, creatividad y muchas ganas de aprender y colaborar.
summary: HABITAT-X is a tool that identifies areas on Earth similar to potential sites for future bases on the Moon and Mars. It compares characteristics such as topography, geology, environmental conditions, and resources using a similarity index. The program ranks potential sites and displays their location and terrain in 3D. The project aims to facilitate the selection of new analog sites where equipment can be tested before future space missions are carried out.
details:
HABITAT-X  aims to compare the physical and environmental characteristics of different locations on the Moon and Mars with places on Earth. The project uses a similarity index to find and rank locations on Earth that have conditions as similar as possible to those on the Moon and Mars. 

The selection of landing sites and base depends on the topography, geology, environment, and available resource. Before sending a mission, teams need to test their systems in places on Earth that are as similar as possible to their destination. Some examples are the Atacama Desert, Haughton crater and Death Valley. 

However, these analog sites have not been completely studied, and only a few places with these characteristics are known. On the other hand, there are many desert, polar, and volcanic regions, as well as caves, that could be useful but have not been studied in an organized way.
